svg.title: The selected base vocabulary
svg.desc: 3 modules, 25 classes and 92 properties selected by this publication. Modules collect related predicates. The same domain can appear in several modules. Concepts defined here are shown as cards; predicates are grouped by domain. Union alternatives read as or. This vocabulary is a starting point; documents can declare other concepts.

g.text: A starting vocabulary. Documents can define other concepts and instances.
Modules collect related predicates. The same domain can appear in several modules.
